parts.script:
Emily: Hey Jake, have you thought about our weekend getaway? I really think we should go to the beach. The weather forecast looks perfect!  
Jake: I agree! But do you think we should book a hotel in advance? Last time, we had a hard time finding a place.  
Emily: Good point. I found a few options online. There’s one that has a nice ocean view and is fairly priced.  
Jake: That sounds great! Can you send me the link?  
Emily: Sure! Also, what kind of activities do you want to do while we’re there? I was thinking we could try some water sports.  
Jake: Water sports sound amazing. I’m keen on trying jet skiing!  
Emily: That’d be fun! We should also check out some local restaurants. I love seafood.  
Jake: Absolutely! And maybe we can find a spot for a bonfire on the beach as well.  
Emily: That would be perfect! Let’s finalize our plans tonight.  
Jake: Sounds good! Looking forward to it!
